newsitem.title: USA: CIBER to buy Technology Management, take Q2 charge.
newsitem.headline: CIBER to buy Technology Management, take Q2 charge.

text.p: CIBER Inc said on Monday that it has signed a definitive agreement to merge Technology Management Group Inc into CIBER.
The company said its second quarter of fiscal 1997 will reflect a charge related to the deal, and added that it expects the merger to be accretive to results for fiscal 1997.

The acquisition will be a tax-free exchange of stock accounted for as a pooling of interests, the company said. It said it will issue about 400,000 shares of its common stock, including options, pursuant to the closing. This is set to take place by November 30 subject to the approval of Technology Management shareholders.
CIBER provides information technology consulting services.

Technology Management is a Bellevue, Wash.- based privately-owned company servicing clients in the area of information technology. The company is operating at an annual revenue rate of about $12 million, CIBER said.
